subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining browser-tool field-report items should become first-class browser API behavior now, rather than staying as skill/docs guidance or narrower follow-up issues?
rationale: The unresolved items span automatic post-action state refresh, stale-ref signaling, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker detection, CDP element inspection, first-snapshot readiness, and fill verification; those change model-facing browser behavior and need owner intent before automation chooses a contract.

options.title: Prioritize stale-state signals
options.body: Keep this issue open and split the remaining work into targeted API/design issues for stale-ref/action-result signals, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker detection, snapshot readiness, and CDP inspection, with one owner-approved contract per PR.

options.title: Limit to guidance
options.body: Document the current recovery loop and defer API additions until stronger live traces show existing selector, batch, wait, ARIA-ref, and skill guidance cannot recover.

options.title: Sponsor broad browser API expansion
options.body: Assign an owner to design the full model-facing browser API surface before implementation rather than landing piecemeal behavior changes.

recommendation.title: Prioritize stale-state signals
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and split the remaining work into targeted API/design issues for stale-ref/action-result signals, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker detection, snapshot readiness, and CDP inspection, with one owner-approved contract per PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most direct merged history for the browser action contract and the shipped partial implementation.
